target: local Apple M4 (G16G), 10 GPU cores, macOS 26.6.2 (25G82)
boundary: public Metal API only; runtime MSL compile of our own carrier kernels; binary-archive splice of our own GENERATED AGX programs (tools/agx-isa isadb.assemble(), driven by this experiment's own generator.py/families.py/cf.py, seeded deterministically); owned shared buffers; every case a fresh process; no Apple binary, archive, BO, or command-stream inspection beyond our own compiled/generated bytes
hypothesis_origin: APPLE9_RE_IMPLEMENTATION_GAPS.md DRV-ISA-01/P0.6, building directly on EXP-0090's hand-built-program-suite and EXP-0101's load-to-ALU bridge rule (docs/isa/register-move-and-liveness.md section 2.7). This experiment's own informal pre-freeze pilot run (PRE_REGISTRATION.md section 5) is the source for the specific expect_match refinements on the REGBOUNDARY/ADVERSARIAL families -- no third-party document is a hypothesis source.

raw_schema.00_env.json: environment/provenance receipt (informational git_revision NEVER gated on -- pinned_revision above + authored_*_sha256 are what matters)
raw_schema.01_results.jsonl: GATED, byte-compared-across-runs: one JSON object per case with keys i,name,group,carrier,oracle,expect_match,notes,status,pipeline_source,out_hex,observed,match -- no nondeterministic field
raw_schema.01_timing.jsonl: NON-GATED sibling: one JSON object per case with keys i,duration_ms,argv,stdout,stderr -- explicitly NOT required to match across runs
raw_schema.02_dispatch.json: run summary: n_cases, status_counts, match_counts, results_sha256, code hashes
raw_schema.STOP.json: written on any pre-capture or capture-time stop; raw/ left absent if pre-capture

pass_criterion: PRE_REGISTRATION.md section 4 -- every expect_match=True case must show status==OK and match==True in BOTH runs; every expect_match=False case's actual match value is recorded against its own pre-registered predicted failure mode (see each case's notes field); 01_results.jsonl gated fields must be byte-identical across both runs.
oracle_source: casematrix.py build_cases() -- pure Python, computed independently of any GPU run, using generator.py's own exact-IEEE754 host arithmetic + isadb.imm_encode/imm_decode for the minifloat immediate domain + families.py's own address-formula/bit-pattern reinterpretation helpers, all established/cited from prior HW-VALIDATED experiments (EXP-0006/EXP-0082/EXP-0086/EXP-0090/EXP-0101), refined by this experiment's own pre-freeze pilot run per PRE_REGISTRATION.md section 5
clean_room: OWN-SHADER + HW-PROBE. Every byte executed is either a program GENERATED by this experiment's own generator.py/families.py/cf.py (each instruction built via tools/agx-isa's own isadb.assemble(), never a copied captured byte string beyond the single labelled verbatim constants documented in isa_helpers.py) or the compiled form of our own kernels/*.metal (tools/shdump, runtime MSL compile via the public Metal API). No third-party document, leaked material, or Apple binary introspection anywhere in this experiment.
